_comment: The Terragen worlds the tools know about. Adding one: put an entry here, run Tools/build_world.py <Name>
to generate Shaders/Worlds/<Name>.ush (and its cloud map), then Tools/ue_setup.py with TG_WORLD=<Name> to
make its Unreal assets, including DA_TerragenWorld_<Name> for ATerragenSkybox. Paths are relative to
ter       its terrain (.ter); ter_convert.py turns it into Textures/<terrain>_height.png/.r16 and .json
ush_args  extra tgw_to_ush.py options (overrides recovered from reference renders, see README)
clouds    generate and use a cloud map (worlds with the sky on)
start     Terragen camera at the skybox actor's location (TerragenStart)
heading   Terragen heading along Unreal +X, also the atlas's Front face
sun       sun heading and altitude the world renders with, for the level's directional light
frames    frames ue_setup.py's GPU check renders (the camera rises 0.067 units per frame)
